schemaOnly.source: Official CLI ephemeral login-role plus cached PostgreSQL 17.6 schema-only pg_dump; public/private, no data export

checks.name: Docker network is internal, no published ports or host data mounts
Actual staging schema-only export restores with the exact reviewed Owner definition and ACL
Selective upgrade preserves function identity, table ACL/RLS/policies and config/audit rows
Non-Owner, expired/revoked Owner and direct client execution denied without writes
Two real PostgreSQL sessions: one commit, one PT409, one audit, no lingering save backend
Exact forward-repair retry is a no-op after committed upgrade
Local PostgREST 14.13 returns HTTP 409/PT409 and permission denials without writes or continuing active retries
Local HTTP normal AI-off save commits exactly one version and one audit

limitations: Platform image and PostgREST minor versions differ from staging; Auth scaffold is not current GoTrue schema
Local restore default grants normalized; snapshot covers app tables/policies and target RPC, not full-platform equivalence
No live Edge/Auth-token or hosted frontend evidence; retry observation is 1.2 seconds
Schema export is not data/Storage backup; no broad rollback to 40001
